newsitem.title: USA: Murdock Communications names Chaplin CEO.
newsitem.headline: Murdock Communications names Chaplin CEO.

text.p: Murdock Communications Corp said Thursday that it had appointed Thomas Chaplin as chief executive.
Before joining Murdock, Chaplin was senior vice president and general manager at APAC TeleServices Inc.
The company said its former chief executive, company founder Guy Murdock, will remain chairman.
Murdock provides telecommunications systems and services, mainly to hotels and motels, through a marketing agreement with AT&T Corp.
